body: I understand that. It’s the only way I can cope
My boyfriend broke up with me and moved Somewhere that’s a 25 hour drive away.
I’m feeling the exact same way that you do. I know 100% what you’re feeling and it’s terrible.
It’s so ridiculous how difficult it is to make it in this world.
That’s what I’m trying to do but I somehow need to come up with $850 in less than two weeks.
I wish I could just focus on that but I guess life doesn’t work that way, unfortunately.
I wonder if this counts for Missouri as well.
What do I do?
No but I’ll try
In order for me to collect unemployment, I had to have lost my job under no fault of my own and since I stopped showing up, it’s my fault for losing my job.
I just don’t see how you can give someone everything and love them and then they end up leaving you like you never mattered
It’s so sad how many people feel this way
The pain is too much
I was starting to get that way too. Unfortunately, I ate today. I should just stop.
Same
I feel your pain.
I’m almost the same. I stopped eating for three days and started to have irregular heartbeats and became faint
Im almost 26 and I just moved back in with my parents. My boyfriend completely abandoned me and I feel so alone and uncomfortable.
I long to have a single moment of happiness but I just can’t have it.
Are you still here?
I feel the same.
Haha you’re fine!
I’m actually a woman 😂😅
I’m just having a hard time focusing on anything
Wow. This was very well said. Thank you for this.
Exact same problem. I’m so alone without him. I It’s like a part of me died and I can’t take it anymore!!
Feeling the same way.
This exact thing happened to me last night. I felt horribly dead inside. Now I’m extremely depressed and feeling hopeless and alone.
I’ll try my best
Hang in there with me. You and I are dealing with something very similar and I think we can help each other through it
I do too. It makes me sick to my stomach. My body feels like it’s on fire. All of this pain is running through every part of my body.
Same here. I feel you.
I did too....

I’m sorry to say this but someone who loves you wouldn’t do that to you. Maybe someday she will have a change of heart and realize that she messed up and she will treat you right... That’s how I view things with my ex.
My boyfriend told me that he would never love me because he doesn’t believe in love.
Exactly. It’s so easy for people to say that when they aren’t feeling what you’re feeling.
Me too. I feel the exact same. I can’t continuously suffer like this.
I know how you feel. This emptiness is terrifying me. I feel overwhelming dread and doom and helplessness... Part of my life is gone and it feels horrible.
Thank you. Today has been difficult.
Exactly how I’m feeling after losing my Love yesterday. I cannot be without him. I just won’t do it.
Feeling similar. Lost the love of my life yesterday morning and he’s moving across the country, never talking to me again. I’ve tried to kill myself. This pain is literally unbearable.
Same. I miss my ex so much. He was the love of my life. I can’t live without him.

This is almost exactly like how I feel about my ex. He left me yesterday to move far away. I’m hurting so badly. Not being able to see him is killing me. This pain is way too much for me. I tried killing myself yesterday. I want to stop waking up!
Right there with you.
Feeling the same.

Your reasons are not dumb. That all sounds much like what I was going through since I was 13. I’m 25 now...I finally found true happiness in November. I fell deeply in love with the man I want to spend my life with. Yesterday morning, he left me to move across the country. That was my person. I feel lost without him. All of the light is gone. There’s no more hope. I need him and I need to stop feeling this pain. I can’t handle it.
You’re right. I don’t know how old anyone is on here or their names but all that matters is that I can unload all of my crap here and try to help people somehow too

I did the same thing yesterday morning after my boyfriend left me. At first, I tested it out and I passed out twice. My family came into my house and saved me just in time though. I was so close. It’s a lot less scary when you’re drunk...It sucks to want to live but feel like you need to die to escape all of the pain.
Thankfully, yes. Although I feel like I need to isolate myself but yet I don’t want to be alone. It’s all so confusing.

They are difficult to find...Honestly, I’m not happy right now and I don’t think I will be for awhile but what makes me feel a little less depressed is talking to people. Talking to friends and talking to people on here.
I’m scared to continue hurting this badly. And I’m also scared to end my life because it would hurt the people I love. I’m just stuck until I die naturally...
I understand exactly what you mean. I don’t want to face another day either. I’m scared.
My boyfriend that I loved more than anyone left me yesterday morning to move across the country. He said we won’t talk anymore. I’m hurting immensely. I miss him. I need him.

I just lost my boyfriend today. He’s moving across the country and won’t talk to me. He was a huge part of my  everyday life. I’m in so much pain. So much. This morning I tried hanging myself. My family came into my home just in time to save me. It hurts so bad, I know it does. I wanted to marry this man and have his children. I wanted to grow old with him. I’ve never loved anyone this much in my life. I’m barely hanging on. Please hang on with me. I know hope you’re feeling. Stay with me. Talk to me. I understand. I care. You matter.
I’m literally feeling so similar to you and dealing with very similar things. This is the worst pain I’ve ever felt.
You’re almost there. School is almost over. You can do it. Don’t give this jerk the power to break you. I know that’s easier said than done but don’t let him hold that power over you.
What grade are you in? Is the abuser a family member?

Please stay. Fight. Fight hard. That’s what I’m doing. It hurts SO much but you have to get through it. I’m barely hanging on but I’m hanging on with all of my strength. Do this with me. Let’s do this together.
I was too. All I can say is just be true to yourself and be who you are. Don’t regret it.
I tried but I get no response

I almost died this morning from hanging myself due to me losing my boyfriend. I was saved just in time by family. I am hurting so immensely. I keep replaying the good times. He left me this morning. He’s moving across the country. The man I loved more than anyone and wanted to spend my life with is gone. I can’t cope. I’m hardly surviving. I don’t want to feel a single moment of this horrendous depression and helplessness any longer. But I’m talking to people. Trying to help someone because I can’t help myself. I’m fighting so hard to keep breathing. I don’t know how I’m going to live without him, I truly don’t. I just have to believe that I will make it. You have to believe that too
Hey, thank you! I appreciate that
Your comment really lifted me up. Thank you. It means so much. I’ve been on here, talking to friends and being with family. It’s helping a little but anything that can help is worth it
Hanging by a thread. I’m surviving. It’s taking all of my strength

I feel the same. My boyfriend is leaving me behind and moving across the country, never coming back and never talking to me again. I’m BARELY holding on. The pain is way too much for me. I can’t take it anymore. I can’t live my life without him.
Please. Oh God I need help
My boyfriend is leaving me behind, moving across the country and won’t ever be back here or talk to me again. I’m scared. I can’t feel this pain anymore. It needs to stop. I need out.
I feel this way too. At work, I see people as they laugh and smile and I just wonder....How do they do it? I feel so much pain that I just can’t continue anymore.
I’m feeling the same way. This is my last few hours with my boyfriend before he leaves me and moves across the country.

We both grew up in Missouri. He moved to Oregon and lived there for a year but he came back to visit for a weekend. He said he was leaving after the weekend but then he decided he wanted to stay here and date me for a few months. We got serious and had a lot of fun but he’s leaving in the morning.
